import base64
script = r'''import base64
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

def main():
    archive_path = sys.argv[1]
    out = sys.stdout
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
        names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')]
    names.sort()
    if not names:
        raise SystemExit('no .faa.mafft members found')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='scogs_pis_') as tmpdir:
        td = pathlib.Path(tmpdir)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
            for name in names:
                target = td / pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).name
                target.write_bytes(zf.read(name))
                cmd = ['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', str(target)]
                try:
                    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
                except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
                    raise SystemExit(f'phykit failed for {name}: {exc.stderr or exc.stdout}')
                fields = proc.stdout.split()
                if len(fields) < 3:
                    raise SystemExit(f'unexpected phykit output for {name}: {proc.stdout"'!r}'"')
                gene = pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).name
                if gene.endswith('.faa.mafft'):
                    gene = gene[:-len('.faa.mafft')]
                out.write('\\t'.join([gene, fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]]) + '\\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
'''
b64=base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode()
print(b64)
print('len', len(b64))
PY"
